_rule: Every `current_text` was taken verbatim from the live file in this worktree and re-verified with a count == 1 check at authoring time. No number is retyped from the memo into the graph: each edit's `artifact` names the file that owns it (CLAUDE.md rule 1).
_not_applied_and_why: DRY RUN ONLY. Three reasons. (1) systems/graph/** is generated-adjacent: any edit must be followed by `python3 systems/systems_check.py --write-views` in the same commit or the view-drift check turns the build red. (2) A8 must land BEFORE A2 or [V4] fails on an unresolvable supporting_evidence ref. (3) This agent was scoped to PROPOSE the re-grade, and a grade-owner move is a judgement call, not a clerical fix.

It does NOT add or retire a blocker. BLK-CLASS-INHERITANCE is more sharply true than before, not less.
